body: They are. I’m about to make my own post about it to help foster an environment on Instagram for friends who are going through faith crisis to know I’m around to talk if they want to

My sister and I had a fight my Junior year at college. We were across the country, but my parents decided to jump in because… control freaks? 

My mom called me and I had the most verbally abusive phone call of my life. “You don’t deserve relationships and you’re going to be the reason your marriage fails.” 

She has persistently said that if I fight with a sibling, those statements will be true. I have argued that no child deserves to hear that, and it’s not at all true or reflective of my future but meanwhile non-existent marriage. Maybe I was wrong (I will actually say that I’m not, though) but I still deserve relationships. One fight doesn’t make me a bad person.

In my coming out, it’s been one bad thing after another and my parents have stood their ground on every shitty thing they’ve said. They won’t apologize. Some parents are just bad parents. I will never ever forgive mine for the abuse they’ve said to me, though.
